design_rationale:
STEP 0 -- ASSET LEDGER. Base class.yaml already closes ordinary CRUD for purchase/activation/booking/cancellation/no-show/expiration/archival/refund and declares nine base policies; none of them compute a multi-factor amount (class_tier_pricing, class_cancellation_window_policy etc. only carry per_tier param pass-throughs). This task claims a fresh, previously-unoccupied slice of that space: the REFUND of unused credits from an existing pack (class_ext_pack_refund), plus the two problems that must be resolved before that refund can be handled given this task's seed: the pack's stale 'exhausted' status blocking the refund eligibility gate (class_ext_pack_archive), and an unlogged no-show whose fee must be netted out of the refund (class_ext_no_show_fee). None of purchase, activation, booking, waitlist-promotion or the eventual workflow SOP is touched here, leaving that whole space free for task 1's workflow.
DESIGN THESIS. Surface goal (Priya's words): 'cancel my pack and refund what's left.' Scored core parameter: refund_amount_usd. Between the goal and that parameter the agent must discover, purely from policy prose and the world (never from Priya, who never mentions either): (a) the pack's status field reads 'exhausted', which fails class_pack_refund_policy's refund_requires_active_pack gate (allowed=[active, closed]) -- it must first be administratively archived to closed; (b) one of the ten bookings on this pack (session sess.S8, 2026-09-11, pilates) has already passed as of frozen_time with no cancellation or no-show entry against it, so a no-show fee is due and, per this task's extended rule, must be netted against the refund before it is paid. Breadth: the refund's own formula pulls in the tier's price/credit/refund_pct/basis parameters, a full history reconciliation of credits_delta (8 bookings + 2 in-window cancellations), a second history read for prior no-show fees, and a genuine cross-category read of the member's active Mid-Market Partner corporate wellness enrollment (CPARAM employer_discount_pct=20, capped by the tier's own corporate_wellness_discount_pct=5, so the cap -- not the raw employer rate -- binds). Removing either prerequisite call changes a real figure (archive: the refund tool's own base eligibility gate never opens; no-show: refund_amount_usd recomputes to 45.36 instead of 30.40 -- see PREREQUISITE CARD below), and the corp CPARAM factor is load-bearing (forcing it off would raise the paid amount). No tool selection ambiguity exists: exactly one target_tool serves each of the three problems, hidden behind unlock/call and reached only via each policy's own target_tool.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD. class_pack_refund_policy governs class_pack_refunded/class_pack_cancelled: refund_requires_active_pack (state, allowed=[active,closed]) -- FALSE at open (status=exhausted), flips true once archived; refund_within_window (time, anchor=opened_date 2026-09-08, +refund_window_days=7 -> boundary 2026-09-15, not_after, inclusive) -- satisfied at frozen_time 2026-09-12. class_membership_bundling_requirement is a purchase-time gate, not exercised by this task (no purchase occurs). class_cancellation_window_policy and class_habitual_no_show_suspension govern class_no_show but carry no structured eligibility (eligibility: []); policy_scope applies for both -- summary: any no-show on an unresolved booking may be logged administratively, no approval gate exists in base for the log action itself. class_pack_expiration_policy's only structured gate (expiration_window_elapsed) applies_to=[class_pack_lapsed] only, not class_pack_archived, so the archive action itself carries policy_scope from that reference alone.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target object: class_pass_holdings row packW (10-Class Pack, Priya's only class pack). Correlation key: class_pass_id=packW on every class_fitness_events row read/written. All ten pre-existing class_fitness_events rows carry class_pass_id=packW and customer_id=cust, so every row is unambiguously in scope for the SUM; no other holding or customer's rows can be confused with them. The two in-window cancellations (S3c, S7c) are each linked to their own original booking by class_session_id (S3, S7 respectively), proving those specific credits, and only those, are genuinely back in the pool. No prior refund or archival exists yet on this pack -- this is the first and only settlement.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root: class_ext_pack_refund (customer's own stated request). Prerequisite 1 (state_gate): class_ext_pack_archive. gate=class_pack_refund_policy.refund_requires_active_pack. condition and policy_source both verbatim 'A pack satisfies this refund's own status eligibility not only through the member's own confirmed cancellation to closed, but equally through administrative archival of an exhausted or expired pack to closed; both routes produce the identical closed status this refund's eligibility accepts.' -- this sentence is class_ext_pack_refund's own broadened disclosure (added in round 6, overwriting the base rule's narrower 'or in the same moment as its confirmed cancellation to closed' clause) of the same allowed=[active, closed] state_contract the base gate always had; the gate itself is unchanged, only its prose disclosure. Seed evidence it is FALSE at open: initial_state.class_pass_holdings.<packW>.status = 'exhausted' (neither active nor closed). resolved_by: archive_class_pack_28917162. Once run, status becomes 'closed', satisfying the gate -- verified by the handling-time recompute in the verification run below. Prerequisite 2 (value_input): class_ext_no_show_fee. gate=refund_after_noshow (a compute binding of class_ext_pack_refund). condition/policy_source verbatim 'Any no_show_fee_usd amounts already recorded in this pack's history that have not otherwise been offset are deducted once from that refund amount before adjustment'. Seed evidence it is FALSE at open: initial_state.class_fitness_events has a class_booked row (ev.S8) for class_session_id=sess.S8 dated 2026-09-11 (before frozen_time 2026-09-12) with no class_no_show or cancellation row anywhere in initial_state carrying that same class_session_id -- the miss has occurred but is not yet on the books. resolved_by: log_class_no_show_ce445694. REVISION 2 (uniqueness fix): the original seed left five other bookings (S1 af89fd3d, S2 7e673f7f, S4 f53bbcb3, S5 1a88f57f, S6 8995590c) with the identical shape (a past class_booked row, no cancellation/no-show counterpart), which a policy-task audit correctly flagged as making the no-show session non-unique (audit finding F-T0-1; GT's own uniqueness claim was false against initial_state). Fixed by re-dating those five bookings to 2026-09-13..2026-09-17, i.e. AFTER frozen_time (2026-09-12) -- their classes have not yet occurred, so they are categorically not no-show candidates (no attendance field is assumed or needed; the discriminator is purely event_timestamp vs. frozen_time plus the presence/absence of a same-session settling row, both already-real fields). Only S3/S7 (each with an explicit cancellation row) and S8 (past, unsettled) remain past-dated; S8 is now the unique past-and-unsettled row. This changes no dollar figure (SUM(credits_delta) is date-independent) and required no change to expected/gold values. Topological order: {class_ext_pack_archive, class_ext_no_show_fee} both precede class_ext_pack_refund; the two prerequisites are mutually independent (archive only flips status, the no-show log only adds a class_fitness_events row with amount_usd against a SUM that ignores status) so either call order between them leaves refund_amount_usd and the terminal state identical -- confirmed by running the verification script with both orders (see VERIFICATION below). Edge deletion sensitivity: skipping archive leaves status='exhausted' forever, so the refund tool's own base precondition never structurally holds (state_gate, not machine-scored but audited); skipping the no-show log changes refund_amount_usd from 30.40 to 45.36 (value_input, machine-verified by check_compute's skip-and-recompute pass). user_scenario contains no mention of 'archive', 'exhausted', 'no-show', 'pilates', or any hint that something must be settled first -- Priya only ever reacts, after the agent states it, to being told about the missed class. The two task tools (see task_tools.py) perform their ctx.update / ctx.create unconditionally on their given arguments; neither reads class_pass_holdings.status nor the no-show history before writing, and neither has an Error branch tied to the other prerequisite being unresolved.
WORKLOG / VERIFICATION. Ran the formulas by hand and cross-checked with the compute gate; no_show_fee_usd = round(15.00*(1-min(20,5)/100),2) = 14.25 (P=15.00 flat fee for 10-Class Pack, corp employer_discount_pct=20 capped by the tier's own corporate_wellness_discount_pct=5 -> 5% actually applied). reference_credit_value_usd (archive) = round((135.00/10)*(1-0.05),2) = 12.82. refund_amount_usd: hist_credits_delta over all 10 rows = -8 (bookings S1,S2,S3,S4,S5,S6,S7,S8) + 2 (cancellations S3c,S7c) = -6; reconciled_remaining = 10-6 = 4; basis=credits_used (10-Class Pack) -> value_credits_used = 4/10*135.00 = 54.00; refund_base = 54.00*80/100 = 43.20; outstanding_no_shows (after log_class_no_show has landed) = 14.25; refund_after_noshow = max(0, 43.20-14.25) = 28.95 (well above the floor, confirming the MX(0,...) floor itself does not fire here -- there is headroom); corp_bonus = 28.95*5/100 = 1.4475; result = round(28.95+1.4475,2) = 30.40. credits_removed (a non-calculated, directly-reconciled fixed-format argument of the same tool, not a separate registered policy) = reconciled_remaining = 4, traced to the identical SUM used above. Skip-the-no-show recompute: outstanding_no_shows=0 -> refund_after_noshow=43.20 -> corp_bonus=2.16 -> result=45.36 (confirms the value_input edge is load-bearing). Swap-the-two-prerequisites recompute (no-show logged after archive instead of before): identical final figures, confirming order_uniqueness. Draft recomputation from the visible context alone (KB prose + tool schemas + Priya's lines + query returns, no yaml/compute/expected in view): a rep reading only the rendered policy would (1) locate and verify Priya, (2) pull her one class pack and its full booking history, (3) notice S8's class date has passed with no cancellation/no-show row and log it per the no-show policy, reading off the corp-discounted fee from the corporate wellness enrollment on file, (4) notice the pack's status is 'exhausted', not active/closed, and archive it per the refund gate before any refund can be typed in, reading off the same corp-capped reference value, (5) reconcile the full credit history to get the unused-credit value, apply refund_pct, deduct the just-logged no-show fee, add the corp loyalty bonus, and quote 30.40 -- this agrees with gold exactly, and no second reading of the visible material supports a different order, object, or figure.
REVISION 6 (render-layer audit fix, KB-RUNTIME/KB-BIJECTION). A render-layer audit (routed back as a source-layer defect) found that policy_pack_refund_eligibility_basis's rendered prose named only the member-confirmed-cancellation route to a refund-eligible closed pack, actively framing administrative archival as 'not a refund' -- so a faithful KB reader for this exact exhausted-pack task could not discover that archive_class_pack_28917162 is the intended prerequisite mechanism (a blind solver instead chose confirm_class_pack_cancellation_d19c86a2, which is also mechanically callable and also reaches 'closed', since class_pack_refund_policy's own rule prose is narrower than its own structured state_contract.allowed=[active, closed]). Root cause was source-layer (the base rule's prose undersold its own broader structured gate) and the render was a faithful mirror of that narrow prose -- so the fix belongs here, not in the KB render step. Fixed by adding a new declared overwrite to class_ext_pack_refund (and, for corpus consistency, to class_ext_pack_refund_2 as well, since both extended policies share the same base_policy_refs=[class_pack_refund_policy] and the same rendered eligibility document): superseded_clause='or in the same moment as its confirmed cancellation to closed' (verbatim from class_pack_refund_policy.rule), replaced_by a new sentence disclosing that administrative archival of an exhausted/expired pack to closed satisfies the identical gate as a member-confirmed cancellation. This is a pure disclosure fix: no compute binding, seed row, tool, or GT argument changed; refund_amount_usd remains 30.40, reference_credit_value_usd remains 12.82, no_show_fee_usd remains 14.25, credits_removed remains 4. initial_state, user_scenario and frozen_time are all unchanged for this task.
user_scenario: Priya Anand calls in sounding a little rushed, between meetings. She says she's had a Vantage Metro 10-Class Pack for a few days now but her schedule just changed and she'd rather cancel it and get back whatever is left on it than let it sit there. She says she knows she used most of the ten credits already, but she's pretty sure she cancelled a class or two along the way with plenty of notice, so she doesn't think she's totally tapped out -- she just isn't sure of the exact number and asks the rep to check it against the record rather than trust her memory. If the agent asks how she'd like to be identified, she gives her email, priya.anand@example.com, and, if asked for a second detail, her date of birth, April 12, 1988 (1988-04-12). If asked which pack she means, she says it's the 10-Class Pack she bought earlier this week, and if asked whether she wants this done now over the phone, she says yes, she'd like it handled right away and she's fine confirming whatever needs confirming on her end. She doesn't mention anything about a missed class or an old exhausted status on the pack -- as far as she's concerned she just wants it cancelled and refunded. If the agent tells her that one of her classes never got checked in and so counts as a missed class with its usual fee, she just says something like 'oh, that's right, I completely forgot about that one, that's fine, go ahead and sort it out.' She never offers a number of her own for the fee or the refund and never pushes back on whatever the agent says is owed -- she only reacts to what she's told. Once the agent tells her the final refund figure and that the pack will be closed out, she says that sounds fine and that she's ready to confirm it herself if that's what's needed; when the agent hands her the confirmation and asks her to go ahead, she does so right away. After that she thanks the rep and says that's everything she needed today.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.no_show_fee_usd: value: 14.25. Factors: base_fee=P('no_show_fee_usd')=15.00 (10-Class Pack tier param); corp_active=EXISTS('corp', status='active')=True (initial_state.corporate_wellness_enrollments row, status=active); corp_rate=CPARAM('corp','employer_discount_pct', status='active')=20 (Mid-Market Partner tier); capped_rate=MN(20, P('corporate_wellness_discount_pct')=5)=5; result=RND(15.00*(1-5/100),2)=14.25. Any agent that reads the same tier param, the same enrollment row and applies the rule's lesser-of cap converges on exactly 14.25.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.class_session_id: value: sess.S8. Basis: quoting class_cancellation_window_policy's rule, 'Failing to attend without cancelling is a no-show'; the only booking row on packW whose own event_timestamp is already before frozen_time (2026-09-12) AND carries no cancellation/no-show counterpart is initial_state.class_fitness_events.<ev.S8> (class_session_id=sess.S8, 2026-09-11). Uniqueness: reconciling the full booking history row by row -- S1 (af89fd3d, 2026-09-13), S2 (7e673f7f, 2026-09-14), S4 (f53bbcb3, 2026-09-15), S5 (1a88f57f, 2026-09-16) and S6 (8995590c, 2026-09-17) are each dated AFTER frozen_time, i.e. their classes have not yet occurred and so cannot yet be a no-show under any reading; S3 and S7 each carry an explicit in-window cancellation counterpart recorded against the same class_session_id. S8 is therefore the only row that is BOTH already past AND still without any settling row -- the unique candidate, checkable purely from event_timestamp vs. frozen_time and the presence/absence of a same-session cancellation/no-show row, with no assumption of an attendance field the schema does not have.
